title: Poverty-related visual semantics and candidate-pack data proposal

evidence_boundary.source_observation: The referenced conversation supplies the keyword families and initial visual motifs.
evidence_boundary.repository_inspection: The current authored visual-obligation registry has 333 profiles, and the 20 *_extension.json files contain 102 visual_semantics rows in total; no poverty-family profile or slot candidate was found.
evidence_boundary.public_research: Official and specialist sources define the semantic axes and claim limits but do not validate any particular generated photograph.
evidence_boundary.design_inference: Candidate scenes translate source-supported constraints into observable relations; they are not claims that the sources prescribed those exact props or compositions.

activation_policy.runtime_label_policy: definition_only_for_hard_profiles; retain neutral broad terms for retrieval but omit demeaning person labels and diagnostic body labels from runtime prose

proposed_profiles.meaning: An unmistakably adult shopper reduces a basic-food purchase because a visibly finite payment resource cannot cover the selected essentials.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 기본 식품을 살 자원이 부족해 한 품목을 원래 진열대로 되돌리고 줄어든 구매 묶음으로 결제를 끝내는 성인
유한한 식비 때문에 장바구니의 필수 식품 하나를 빼고 남은 품목만 구입하는 성인
exact_activation_phrases_en: an adult returns one basic food item because a visibly finite grocery budget cannot cover the selected essentials, then completes the reduced purchase
an adult removes one staple from an essential grocery basket under a finite food budget and pays for the smaller set
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Keep the original essential set, finite payment resource, returned item path and reduced paid set readable in one checkout-to-shelf relation without relying on legible prices.

proposed_profiles.meaning: A nearly depleted household food source is actively divided into several bounded portions, leaving a visible post-allocation remainder or empty source.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 거의 소진된 동일 식량 용기에서 남은 양을 여러 몫으로 나누고 분배 뒤 빈 용기가 남는 성인들
남은 주식 한 용기를 같은 프레임의 여러 끼 분량으로 나누어 두는 성인
exact_activation_phrases_en: adults divide the nearly depleted contents of one household food container into several bounded portions, leaving the source visibly empty
an adult portions the last visible staple supply from one source container across several meals in the same frame
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Show the source container, transfer action, every destination portion and the source after allocation at inspectable scale.

proposed_profiles.meaning: One adult allocates a finite household resource to one of two concrete basic needs and visibly defers the other.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 한정된 생활비를 두 필수 필요 중 하나에 배정하고 다른 하나를 즉시 미루는 성인
식비와 난방비처럼 두 기본 필요가 충돌해 하나를 충족하고 다른 하나의 공급을 미루는 장면
exact_activation_phrases_en: an adult allocates a finite household budget to one of two concrete basic needs and visibly defers the other
two essential household needs compete for one finite resource; the same adult meets one and leaves the other immediately unresolved
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Use a single decision surface that connects one finite resource to two essential need anchors and preserves both the satisfied and deferred outcomes without readable private data.

proposed_profiles.meaning: An occupied home has intact but unavailable or unaffordable heating or cooling service, and adults visibly consolidate activity or seal heat transfer while the room-wide consequence remains visible.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 점유 중인 집에서 난방비 또는 서비스 제약으로 난방원이 멈춘 채 성인들이 한 구역에 생활을 모으고 외풍을 막는 장면
감당할 수 없는 냉난방 서비스 때문에 같은 방에 모여 단열·차광으로 대응하는 성인 가구
exact_activation_phrases_en: in an occupied home, unaffordable or unavailable heating leaves the intact heat source inactive while adults consolidate activity and seal drafts
adults in an occupied home cope with unaffordable cooling by shading and consolidating one usable zone while the room-wide heat consequence remains visible
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Connect the inactive service source, occupied room, coping action and ambient consequence in one spatial chain; do not substitute blue grading or visible breath alone.

proposed_profiles.meaning: A currently occupied dwelling contains one traceable cold, damp, leak, ventilation or sanitation defect that affects a living zone while an adult performs a temporary mitigation.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 현재 거주 중인 집에서 누수·습기·외풍의 원인과 생활공간 영향이 이어지고 성인이 임시 완화를 하는 장면
점유 주거의 거주 가능성 결함을 추적해 물받이·밀봉·환기로 대응하지만 결함이 남아 있는 장면
exact_activation_phrases_en: in a currently occupied dwelling, one traceable leak damp or draft path affects the living zone while an adult performs a temporary mitigation
an adult traces and mitigates one habitability defect in an occupied home while the defect source and remaining consequence stay visible
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Frame the defect source, its physical path, the affected living zone and the mitigation together; preserve signs of ordinary occupancy without exposing personal data.

proposed_profiles.meaning: The same adult's completed paid-work output and compensation are linked to concrete essential household costs that still exceed the available resource.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 유급 교대를 마친 같은 성인의 작업 결과와 보상을 기본 생활비와 대조했을 때 남는 부족이 보이는 장면
일을 마친 성인이 받은 보상을 식비·주거·교통 같은 필수비용에 배분해도 한 항목이 미충족으로 남는 장면
exact_activation_phrases_en: the same adult's completed paid shift and compensation remain linked to essential household costs that still exceed the available resource
after paid work, an adult allocates the compensation across food housing or transport essentials and one necessary item remains unmet
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Connect workplace evidence to the same adult's compensation and household-cost decision without relying on job stereotypes, a readable wage figure or fatigue.

proposed_profiles.meaning: An adult's concrete essential trip is blocked at a transport boundary by a visible fare or access-resource gap while the usable route departs or closes.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 필수 이동 목적을 가진 성인이 운임 자원 부족으로 교통 경계를 통과하지 못하고 차량이 떠나는 장면
출근·진료 같은 구체적 이동이 운임 또는 접근 비용 장벽에서 막혀 동일 성인이 출발편을 놓치는 장면
exact_activation_phrases_en: an adult's concrete essential trip is blocked at a transit boundary by a visible fare-resource gap while the usable vehicle departs
a fare or access-cost barrier prevents the same adult from making an essential trip as the viable route closes
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Keep the adult, fare medium, gate or boarding point, essential-trip anchor and departing route on one readable travel axis without requiring legible destination text.

proposed_profiles.meaning: An essential item with localized functional wear is actively repaired because replacement is unavailable, then visibly returned to continued use while remaining cared for.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 교체할 수 없는 필수 생활품의 국소 마모를 성인이 수선하고 다시 사용 상태로 돌려놓는 장면
필수 신발·가방·의복의 기능 손상을 임시 수선해 계속 사용하는 자원 제약 장면
exact_activation_phrases_en: an adult repairs localized functional wear on an essential daily item because replacement is unavailable, then returns it to continued use
a resource-constrained repair restores an essential shoe bag or garment to use while preserving visible care and localized wear
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Show the worn load point, repair contact, limited replacement context and returned function; avoid uniform dirt, decorative distress and class-coded styling.

proposed_profiles.meaning: The same ordinary activity or service is visibly accessible to others while one adult is blocked by a concrete affordability or resource boundary, producing an immediate participation gap.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 같은 활동에 다른 성인들은 정상 참여하지만 한 성인은 구체적 비용 장벽 때문에 같은 문턱에서 참여하지 못하는 장면
공공·사회 활동의 접근 흐름과 비용 경계, 차단된 한 성인의 즉시 참여 결과가 함께 보이는 장면
exact_activation_phrases_en: the same ordinary activity is accessible to other adults while one adult is blocked at the same threshold by a concrete affordability boundary
normal participation flow, a cost-resource boundary and one adult's immediate exclusion from the same activity remain visible together
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Use one shared threshold and one ordinary activity so access difference is caused by the visible resource boundary, not by appearance, protected traits or social hostility.

proposed_profiles.meaning: An adult's concrete essential digital task is limited by an affordability, shared-device or timed-access constraint, prompting a visible workaround and leaving an unfinished result.
exact_activation_phrases_ko: 필수 디지털 과업을 수행하는 성인이 비용·공유기기·시간 제한 때문에 공용 접속으로 우회하지만 과업이 미완료로 남는 장면
감당 가능한 연결이 없어 성인이 제한된 공유 기기 시간 안에 필수 신청·학습·업무를 끝내지 못하는 장면
exact_activation_phrases_en: an adult's essential digital task is limited by an affordability shared-device or timed-access constraint, prompting a public-access workaround and leaving the task unfinished
without affordable connectivity, an adult uses a time-limited shared device for an essential application learning or work task that remains incomplete
proposed_profiles.composition_instruction: Keep the functional device, access constraint, essential task, workaround and interruption visible without depending on readable private screen content.

proposed_candidates.ko: 기본 식품과 유한한 지불 자원을 함께 확인하는 명백한 성인 구매자

proposed_candidates.en: an unbranded basic-food shop where shelf basket and checkout remain on one readable path without legible price dependence
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: ordinary staple display basket and payment point form one continuous selection and return path

proposed_candidates.en: a composition aligning the source shelf, returning hand, finite payment medium and reduced paid set
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the same-frame axis proves where the removed staple came from why the set shrank and what remained for purchase

proposed_candidates.ko: 되돌린 한 품목의 진열 공백과 결제된 더 작은 필수 식품 묶음이 함께 남는 결과
proposed_candidates.en: the returned item's restored shelf position and the smaller completed essential purchase remain visible together
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: a completed but reduced food purchase is distinguishable from indecision or ordinary comparison

proposed_candidates.ko: 한 공급원에서 여러 몫을 나누는 명백한 성인 한 명 또는 성인 공동생활 구성원들
proposed_candidates.en: one unmistakably adult allocator or an adult household group dividing several portions from one source
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: adults retain agency while one identifiable person transfers a near-depleted supply into bounded portions

proposed_candidates.ko: 거의 빈 식량 용기의 남은 양을 계량해 여러 용기나 끼니 몫으로 실제 옮기기
proposed_candidates.en: measuring and transferring the remaining contents of a nearly empty food container into several meal portions
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the transfer action visibly links one near-empty staple source to every destination portion

proposed_candidates.ko: 남은 공급 용기와 분배 용기가 같은 프레임에 놓이는 점유 중인 소박한 부엌·식탁
proposed_candidates.en: an occupied ordinary kitchen or table keeping the remaining supply container and all destination portions in one frame
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: ordinary lived-in setting supports supply allocation without rustic ruin or staged food styling

proposed_candidates.ko: 바닥이 드러난 무상표 주식 용기와 서로 구분되는 여러 분배 용기
proposed_candidates.en: an unbranded staple container with its bottom exposed beside several clearly separate destination containers
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: one identifiable source has too little remaining content and every portion is physically traceable back to it

proposed_candidates.ko: 원래 용기·옮기는 도구·여러 목적 용기·분배 후 잔량을 모두 보존하는 탑다운 또는 사선 구도
proposed_candidates.en: a top-down or oblique frame preserving source container transfer utensil all destination portions and post-allocation remainder
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: one continuous transfer geometry distinguishes constrained allocation from plated cuisine or ordinary meal prep

proposed_candidates.ko: 여러 몫이 마련된 뒤 원래 식량 용기에 거의 아무것도 남지 않은 분배 결과
proposed_candidates.en: after several portions are set aside, the original food container remains visibly empty or nearly depleted
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the source after allocation records the constrained total without using hunger expressions or body cues

proposed_candidates.ko: 서로 다른 두 필수 필요와 하나의 유한한 자원을 직접 배분하는 명백한 성인
proposed_candidates.en: an unmistakably adult household decision-maker directly allocating one finite resource between two distinct basic needs
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the same adult owns the allocation action and both immediate household consequences without a poverty appearance label

proposed_candidates.ko: 한 필수 필요에 지불·공급을 완료하고 다른 필수 필요의 물품이나 서비스를 다시 미룸 상태로 두기
proposed_candidates.en: completing payment or provision for one basic need while visibly returning the other basic need to a deferred state
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: one finite resource moves to one essential need and the same adult leaves the competing need unresolved

proposed_candidates.ko: 식품·난방·주거·교통 중 두 필수 필요와 실제 공급 결과가 함께 보이는 생활공간의 결정대
proposed_candidates.en: a household decision surface where two essential needs and their actual provision states remain visible together
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: ordinary domestic context exposes the tradeoff without private account text or sensationalized hardship

proposed_candidates.ko: 무상표 식품 묶음과 난방·주거·교통 같은 두 번째 필수 서비스 단서, 하나의 제한된 지불 자원
proposed_candidates.en: an unbranded food bundle, a second essential-service anchor such as heating housing or transport, and one limited payment resource
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: two basic needs visibly compete for one shared household resource without legible personal bills

proposed_candidates.ko: 중앙의 제한 자원에서 충족된 필요와 미뤄진 필요로 갈라지는 인과 구도
proposed_candidates.en: a causal split composition running from one central finite resource to one met need and one deferred need
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: both outcomes remain equally readable so the scene cannot collapse into generic bills or budgeting

proposed_candidates.ko: 한 필수 항목은 공급 준비가 끝났지만 다른 항목은 봉인되거나 꺼진 상태로 남는 즉시 결과
proposed_candidates.en: one essential need is visibly provisioned while the competing item or service remains set aside inactive or unresolved
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the post-decision state preserves both sides of the basic-needs constraint without requiring readable labels

proposed_candidates.ko: 점유 중인 생활공간에서 한 사용 구역을 유지하도록 함께 대응하는 명백한 성인들
proposed_candidates.en: unmistakably adult occupants coordinating to maintain one usable zone inside their occupied home
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: adults remain active problem-solvers rather than passive cold-body symbols

proposed_candidates.ko: 꺼진 냉난방원 주변이 아니라 한 방에 활동을 모으고 외풍 차단·차광·담요 배치로 열교환을 줄이기
proposed_candidates.en: consolidating household activity into one room and reducing heat transfer with draft sealing shading or shared insulation
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: practical thermal coping responds to an inactive service source and changes how the occupied room is used

proposed_candidates.ko: 일상 점유 흔적과 비활성 냉난방 설비, 한 구역으로 모인 생활이 함께 보이는 집 안
proposed_candidates.en: an occupied domestic room showing ordinary use, an inactive heating or cooling source and activity consolidated into one zone
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: lived-in domestic context prevents confusion with ruins outages and empty real-estate interiors

proposed_candidates.ko: 정상 형태지만 가동되지 않는 냉난방원과 실제 접촉된 문풍지·두꺼운 커튼·차광재
proposed_candidates.en: an intact but inactive heating or cooling source with physically installed draft seals heavy curtains or shading material
aliases: inactive service and installed coping materials
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: service source and material coping remain physically connected to the occupied room rather than acting as decorative winter props

proposed_candidates.ko: 비활성 서비스원·실내 경계·대응하는 손·집중된 생활 구역·방 전체 결과를 깊이축으로 잇는 구도
proposed_candidates.en: a depth composition linking inactive service source, room boundary, coping hands, consolidated living zone and ambient consequence
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the thermal problem and response share one physical room so color grading cannot substitute for evidence

proposed_candidates.ko: 냉난방원은 꺼져 있고 외풍 차단이 설치되며 일상 물품이 한 작은 사용 구역에 모인 결과
proposed_candidates.en: the service source remains inactive while installed draft or shade controls and ordinary objects cluster in one actively used zone
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the room records adaptation to constrained thermal service without visible suffering or health claims

proposed_candidates.ko: 거주 중인 집의 한 결함 경로를 추적하고 임시 완화를 수행하는 명백한 성인 거주자
proposed_candidates.en: an unmistakably adult occupant tracing one defect path and performing a temporary mitigation in a lived-in home
aliases: adult occupant mitigating a housing defect
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: the occupant acts with practical agency while no class health or hygiene trait is inferred

proposed_candidates.ko: 누수·습기·외풍·환기 문제의 시작점을 확인하고 물받이·밀봉·환기 같은 임시 대응을 설치하기
proposed_candidates.en: tracing the source of a leak damp draft or ventilation problem and installing a temporary catch seal or airflow response
aliases: trace and mitigate one habitability defect
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: one physical defect causes a visible living-zone consequence and receives a material response without pretending the repair is complete

proposed_candidates.ko: 일상 점유 흔적과 결함의 시작점·이동 경로·영향 구역이 동시에 보이는 주거 내부
proposed_candidates.en: a lived-in dwelling interior where ordinary occupancy, defect source, physical path and affected zone remain visible together
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: ordinary occupancy distinguishes housing habitability from abandoned ruins or construction documentation

proposed_candidates.ko: 물받이·흡수포·문풍지·환기 도구처럼 결함 원인에 실제로 접촉한 비상 완화 물품
proposed_candidates.en: temporary mitigation items such as a catch basin absorbent cloth draft seal or ventilation aid physically contacting the defect path
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: mitigation objects physically intercept the leak moisture airflow or draft rather than acting as generic clutter

proposed_candidates.ko: 결함 시작점에서 물·습기·공기 경로, 생활 영향, 대응하는 손으로 이어지는 인과 구도
proposed_candidates.en: a causal frame running from defect origin through moisture water or airflow path to living-zone impact and the mitigating hand
proposed_candidates.embedding_text: same-frame physical causality prevents a single mold patch or cracked wall from standing in for housing poverty

proposed_candidates.ko: 임시 대응은 설치되었지만 결함 흔적과 그 공간의 계속된 일상 사용이 함께 남는 결과
proposed_candidates.en: the temporary response is installed while the defect trace and continued ordinary use of the affected space both remain visible
